# Routed through oe_gk_monthly_dispatch / oe_gk_yearly_dispatch with full global_var deduplication.
# Generated by gen_v150_kernel_ux.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Global oe_heg_ai_monthly scan moved to oe_global_kernel.txt; human-only self-check kept here.

monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_heg_ai_human_pulse
	}
}

oe_heg_ai_human_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1200
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		NOT = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_off = yes }
		NOT = { var:oe_heg_ai_hum_m ?= oe_heg_ai_m_now }
	}
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_hum_m value = oe_heg_ai_m_now }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_heg_ai_test_force ?= 1 } }
			oe_heg_ai_eval_candidate = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg_ai_active value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
